notes.title: Pausing our Galactic Journey 🚀
notes.content:
Back in July 2020, we embarked on a thrilling gamedev journey together during the GMTK Game Jam, where the seeds of Spacebus were planted.

Since then, we’ve been on a rollercoaster of creativity, growth, and learning. As a fledgling studio, Spacebus marked our inaugural project, teaching us invaluable lessons in planning, scope, development, management, and design. The support and enthusiasm from our amazing community have fueled our passion and commitment.

However, after careful consideration, we have decided to pause development on Spacebus. Throughout development, we found ourselves grappling with the gameplay loop - attempting to strike the delicate balance between depth and the frenetic, fast-paced action that defines the Spacebus experience. Our ambition led us to expand the game’s scope, introducing a world map, quests, RPG elements, and more. However, amidst this exploration, we unintentionally strayed from the heart of the game. Despite scrapping and restarting the core gameplay loop multiple times, we couldn’t quite capture the fun and chaos we had originally captured during the jam.

Rather than tinkering endlessly, we believe that putting Spacebus on the back burner for a bit will allow us to return with renewed passion and creativity to create a game that truly reflects the vision we hold dear.

So what’s next? While Spacebus takes a brief hiatus, we're exploring new frontiers, gaining fresh insights, and gearing up for future endeavors. . We encourage you to stay tuned for updates on our evolving journey and new projects on the horizon.

Thank you for your unwavering support, your enthusiasm, and for being part of the Incredulous family. We look forward to the day when we can reignite the engines and resume our (government-subsidized) celestial journey together.

Until next time,

🌌 Incredulous Interactive (Ryan & Josh)

notes.title: Spacebus is Evolving - Now Releasing Summer 2021
notes.content:
[h2]Spacebus is Evolving![/h2]

As Spacebus continues to grow, we've added tons of new features that vastly improve the gameplay.
For example:
[list]
[*] Full Story Mode
[*] Multiple Ship Layouts
[*] UX Overhaul of the Central Game Mechanics
[*] Cutscenes
[*] And more!
[/list]
We're almost finished adding these new changes, but we want to give ourselves enough time to properly test and market this game before release. 

Stay tuned for more updates as we get closer to launch!
[i]-Incredulous Devs[/i]

notes.title: Spacebus Takes Flight April 30
notes.content:
What started as a Game Jam experiment in July of 2020 has now become a full-fledged game! 

With multiple levels and environments, a dynamically-generated worldmap, multiple upgrade trees, and a full story mode, Spacebus has grown in scope from a simple arcade-style platformer to a grand public-transportation-themed space epic!

Spacebus takes flight [b]Friday, April 30, 2021.[/b] 
Be sure to add it to your wishlist now to stay up to date on the latest updates!

[i]-Incredulous Devs[/i]
